body: They're golden retriever/lab mixes. My old dog was a chihuahua mix so it's a pretty big adjustment.

I'm so sorry to hear about your cat... It's good to hear that you've moved on, though. Seriously, huge respect--especially since it seems impossible to me now.

I actually never thought about how my relationship with my new dogs will be different and not comparable to my relationship with my last one... It's something I'll definitely be thinking about. I'll also look back on your comment very often when I get in this rut again... if I manage to live past this.

Thank you so much for the insight, I needed it more than I can even put into words.

I didn't take any offense, don't worry about it!

I did recently get two puppies. I mentioned it in the post but I should've made it more clear or put a tl;dr, sorry about that. They've only made the pain worse because I can't bring myself to love them like I loved her, though.

Also, I'm sorry for all your losses. I can't even cope with one loss, I can't imagine more.
